notes: Dynamax Desktop v3.1.30 connects scoped HR positions and staff details to letters and directories across all editions. Includes automatic directory search with a Search button, configured manual-payment amount autofill, subscriber-branded letter formatting, PDF preview lock protection, ICT and delegated approval entry points, and responsive CBT controls with school branding. The 5,000-candidate CBT software target requires a successful rehearsal on the actual school server and network; it is not a hardware capacity guarantee. Includes all previous desktop repairs. Connected HR data and online approval features require the current organisation backend. Installation preserves organisation settings and does not change payments, receipts, balances, stock, permissions or previously issued documents.
